_doc: Review notes tracker (shorts-quality-gate): {id, round, scene, frame, severity, rule, text, fix, status}. Status: open | fixed | verified | wontfix | escalate.

notes.text: Final cover clock: empty band above the clock, clock bottom close to the caption
notes.fix: Raise the clock ~30 px or fill the top

notes.text: Child and grandparent too small to read age
notes.fix: Close-up of the pair, height ratio, grey hair, glasses, cane

notes.text: Flat sun in an empty sky, no horizon
notes.fix: Sky backdrop with a horizon; the sun rises and sets behind it

notes.text: Physics (anticipation, squash, bounce) never checked: only 2 fps sheets were used
notes.fix: Per-frame strips with scripts/frame-strip.mjs on landings and cuts; watch final.mp4

notes.text: Survey lines on the skewed billboard plane: «не ускорялись» reads as slowing, the plateau as a decline; the waiver covers the billboard, not slanted lines
notes.fix: Frontal plate on the billboard with horizontal axes; register plane frontal

notes.text: Racing clock with speed lines under «Час не ускорился» / «А час останется часом»: the picture says the opposite of the voice
notes.fix: Real-speed hand, no speed lines there; racing clock only for «время летит» and the cover (register it)

notes.text: Monthly calendar pages say «months fly» (contradicts S1); falling into the tray grows the memory pile
notes.fix: Yearly pages; pages do not land in the tray

notes.text: Second images for known concepts: catalogue duplicates the tray, tape duplicates pile height and suggests a literal measurement
notes.fix: Remove the tape; end with cards going to the tray; register the catalogue as a close-up of the tray

notes.text: «Поэтому взрослые годы и летят» states hypothesis S4 as fact; grey cards from the register are not on screen
notes.fix: «Возможно, поэтому…» (one voice regeneration, ~3 words); add or drop grey cards

notes.text: 16 candles at «50 лет» can be read as the age
notes.fix: Keep the candle count constant or remove candles
